_about: Manifest of every raw source the report reads. Add one entry per new file. as_of = when the numbers were read from Publer (Asia/Bangkok). Later as_of wins when two sources describe the same post. Never edit or delete old raw files: they are the audit trail and enable age-matched comparisons later.
